findings.message: .starcistacks/application-stacks.yaml declares no component for the api app be/apps/relay: none named `relay` and none mapped to it by `environments.<env>.deploy.images.<component>.app: relay`; every service of a multi-service product is a `role: service` component (own image at an exact version, built from be/apps/relay/Dockerfile).

.starcistacks/application-stacks.yaml: .starcistacks/production/infra/swarm/stack.yaml: .starcistacks/production/infra/swarm/stack.yaml: services.relay: Swarm service name must be a declared component id
